decisions.scope: Separately named copied C successor; frozen receipt and SDK bytes unchanged. No production integration, full community loader, fault attribution, native target or observer.
decisions.sdk_policy: Retain ID lookup, caller half-open envelope, current-loading init, hooks_ok, target-start text envelope and sixteen-byte overlap semantics. Retain exact cm_id_ok, cm_find and cm_called_by bodies; cm_claim_hook orchestration is explicitly transformed. Inline claim does not call cm_self and supplies no frame-thread or LOADED-state veto; do not import those or vslot policy.
decisions.identity: Use 33-byte owned ID storage throughout renamed receipt owner/module/ledger fields, accepting all 32 SDK ID characters plus NUL. Never truncate or infer Core from an ID string.
decisions.signature: int claim_hook(const char*, uintptr_t, void*, void**), SDK 0 for normally returned published receipt including warnings, -1 before publication. Raw installer -3/-1/0/1 and richer receipt remain separate.
decisions.caller: Capture CM_RA exactly once at outer noinline SDK-signature entry before helper calls; capture one acquire-loaded internal active-session handle there. Future runtime injection enters a separately named authored-RA seam; it does not validate the builtin or native provenance.
decisions.session: One atomic unsigned active handle: 0 closed, index+1 names a fixed immutable one-use session, at most four. No independent index/generation reads, counter wrap, slot reuse or reopen. Same captured nonzero handle must still be current and match cm_find result under cm->writer. Never refresh queued input to a later session. One-use means one open epoch per module index, not one hook: multiple known bindings can claim within it. Immutable payload contains index/identity; mutable open/loading/count fields are accessed only under locks. Implement one combined new veto: captured==0 || captured!=current || captured!=index+1. After it passes, construct the private permit from the locked resolved current session; the captured handle is not separately rechecked in the private installer.
decisions.locking: One SDK recursive cm -> one nonrecursive common writer -> actual azmod protection. Core only writer->protection. Remove receipt's second cm/epoch/module_hooks authority in copied successor; call private already-locked installer. No writer->cm edge or recursive public receipt call.
decisions.lifecycle: Initialize fixed tables once; record and module/session slots have process lifetime. Publish immutable loader inputs before entry/descriptor validation. Open one session after descriptor acceptance; release locks before init callback; reacquire cm->writer to close and freeze count before selected failure/success state updates. No lock spans external callback or loader work.
decisions.loader: Authored explicit handle-present, link-map-query-success, link-map-present, matched object identity, base-valid and base value plus bounded PT_LOAD scratch; accept valid zero base, reject absent provenance or checked endpoint overflow. No actual dlopen/dlinfo/enumeration/entry/parser/approval/quarantine/file operations.
decisions.capability: Authored manifest hooks and firmware-any inputs feed the retained hooks && !any relation; hooks && any is refused at the selected loader boundary. hooks_ok remains the exact inline predicate. Not a new general capability token or a vslot replacement-range/thread rule.
decisions.custody: Before resource calls resolve exact permanent process-image target/replacement/plain aligned original descriptor and check pointer identity without dereferencing rejected orig. Preserve one attempt, target/storage reservations, strong initialized originals and lifetime through failed init. Authored claimant envelope and replacement custody are separate facts. Remove the copied receipt's extra replacement-in-claimant-envelope admission test: exact fixed replacement identity/custody replaces it. SDK caller-envelope policy remains unchanged.
decisions.modules: Fixed immutable per-index committed loader records; original cm index order and retained min/max PT_LOAD envelope semantics. Snapshot all committed module envelopes under writer for storage exclusion. Core never reads mutable cm fields. Later module masking and gap/non-executable membership remain; generated lookup stays separate.
decisions.capacity: Prevalidate fixed binding/metadata/journal/common target-ledger and per-module accounting capacity before installer. Checked target+16 for new/existing conflicts. No silent diagnostic-capacity admission, postcut capacity failure or retry.
decisions.accounting: A normal returned receipt with actual redirect_published consumes exactly one pre-reserved SDK nhooks increment under cm->writer, even warnings and later init failure. One per-attempt accounted flag; no independent module_hooks. Refusal before redirect adds zero; consumed binding/journal/uncertain custody retained. Do not equate RC_OK=0 with raw installer1 or use diagnostic table as authority.
decisions.permit: Private permit binds immutable session identity, known binding and reservation during uninterrupted locks. The single locked admission decision grants the epoch lease; private final validation checks bound immutable data and actual receipt storage, not a second mutable epoch authority. All refusal before target unlock; cut stays metadata then real plain original then target redirect.
decisions.logs: Copy bounded diagnostic values while admitted, release locks, then invoke authored log sink. No source-derived file/log persistence claim. Do not re-read mutable state to determine result after unlock.
decisions.unsupported: Unexpected result/publication inconsistencies preserve resources and terminal incomplete/unknown evidence; do not retry or pretend recoverable ordinary refusal. Signals, forced exits and interruptions remain outside the normal-return protocol.

transformations.change: Extract exact cm_id_ok/cm_find bodies into a separately named bounded offline translation unit; preserve first-index string match. Initialize/count records only under recursive cm, never expose an uninitialized prefix. Use authored valid readable ID buffers; arbitrary pointer probing is excluded.

Preserve cm_called_by body. Capture CM_RA and atomic session handle at outer noinline SDK-signature entry; helper receives values. Add separately named authored-value entry only under fixture configuration; never silently redefine CM_RA.

Relocate predicates into single recursive cm->writer admission; retain predicate meanings and order, then add explicit session match, descriptor custody/capacity and checked conflict guards. Separate refusal diagnostics from mutation.

Factor copied receipt installer into private writer-held transaction; remove nested cm/writer reacquisition, independent fixture epoch and module_hooks count. Pass copied typed owner, committed module envelopes and bound known descriptor. Keep Core wrapper writer-only. Full diff against frozen source required. Remove the old replacement-in-module-envelope proxy; exact fixed replacement custody is independently checked.
Widen copied owner/module ID arrays from32 to33; fixed slot objects remain strong aligned plain void* with explicit initialization. Do not cast atomics as void** or infer arbitrary slot lifetime.

Replace OS loader/parser inputs with declared authored tuple and checked scratch builder; one-way per-index module publication before authored descriptor check. Retain handle marker/module even when descriptor refused. This is a transformed selected fragment, not execution of full cm_load_one.

Open immutable one-use session under cm->writer, release before authored init callback, then reacquire same order to close and snapshot nhooks before failure cleanup/state updates. Add one-start guard and prohibit reopening index; never hold locks across callbacks.

Replace raw integer-only status mapping with actual receipt publication plus preserved raw result; published warnings map SDK0 and increment nhooks once before unlock. Keep failed-init suffix tied to retained count. Logging after unlock uses copied facts.

Replace single module_value exclusions with bounded immutable module view and immutable permit inputs. Do not change actual emission, cleanup/token semantics or lexical publication cut without separate ledger entry. All guards stay preunlock.

Make common target reservation authoritative for Core/community; keep inherited diagnostic hook note underwriter and pre-reserved capacity, never use optional diagnostics to reverse publication. Preserve no retry and one-way ownership.
